headline.title: The $400 million machine powering the future of chipmaking
headline.summary: A new $400 million machine designed for advanced chipmaking is being showcased by Jos Benschop, featuring a massive structure comparable to a double-decker bus. This innovative equipment is equipped with intricate systems of tubes, cables, and tanks, highlighting the complexity and scale of modern semiconductor manufacturing technology.

articles.title: NVIDIA Powers Over 400 of the World’s 500 Fastest Supercomputers
articles.summary: NVIDIA technology powers over 400 of the world's 500 fastest supercomputers, accounting for 81% of the TOP500 list and 90% of the newly listed systems. Additionally, 26 systems have adopted the NVIDIA Grace CPU, and the top eight systems on the Green500 rankings utilize NVIDIA GPUs.

articles.title: ARVO: Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities for Open-Source Software
articles.summary: The ARVO project introduces the Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities for Open-Source Software, addressing the challenge of achieving reproducibility, quantity, and diversity in vulnerability datasets. The initiative aims to enhance the utility of historical bug datasets for security research by prioritizing reproducibility, which has often been overlooked.

articles.title: NVIDIA Brings Trusted, 24/7 AI Agents to Telecom Operations
articles.summary: NVIDIA has introduced trusted AI agents designed to enhance telecom operations by automating network management, customer care, and back-office functions. This shift from task-based automation to greater autonomy aims to improve efficiency and decision-making within the telecom industry.

articles.title: The running list: major tech layoffs in 2026 where employers cited AI
articles.summary: In 2026, several major tech companies have announced significant layoffs, citing AI as a contributing factor. This article provides a chronological list of these layoffs, detailing the companies involved and the context surrounding the decisions.

articles.title: How Omio is building the future of conversational travel
articles.summary: Omio is leveraging OpenAI to enhance conversational travel experiences and streamline product development, positioning itself as an AI-native company. The integration of AI technology aims to improve user interactions and overall service efficiency in the travel sector.

articles.title: AI chipmaker Groq confirms $650M raise, re-staffs after Nvidia’s $20B not-acqui-hire deal
articles.summary: AI chipmaker Groq has confirmed a $650 million funding round as it refocuses on its neocloud business and expands its executive team following Nvidia's $20 billion not-acqui-hire deal. The company aims to strengthen its position in the AI market amid ongoing competition.

articles.title: A-Evolve-Training: Autonomous Post-Training of a 30B Model
articles.summary: Researchers have developed an autonomous system, A-Evolve-Training, that post-trains a 30 billion parameter model without human intervention, completing multiple training rounds over several weeks. The resulting model achieved a performance score of 0.86, closely competing with the top human submission score of 0.87 on the NVIDIA Nemotron-Reasoning Challenge.

articles.title: Fara-1.5: Scalable Learning Environments for Computer Use Agents
articles.summary: FaraGen1.5 is a new scalable data pipeline designed for training computer use agents, consisting of modular components that include environments, solvers, and verifiers. This system aims to address the challenges of collecting human demonstration data by enabling efficient generation strategies for agent training.

articles.title: Text2DSL: LLM-Based Code Generation for Domain-Specific Languages
articles.summary: The paper presents Text2DSL, a new approach for automatic code generation in domain-specific languages (DSLs) from natural language descriptions, addressing the challenges of manual rule authoring in operating system security policies. It introduces the PolkitBench dataset, which contains 4,204 examples to support research in this area.

articles.title: IPO Finance Agent: Evaluation of LLM Financial Analysts beyond Finance Agent v2, with Automated Rubric Generation -- the Case of the SpaceX (SPCX) IPO
articles.summary: The article evaluates the effectiveness of the Finance Agent v2 benchmark in assessing large language models (LLMs) like Anthropic Claude and OpenAI ChatGPT for financial analysis, specifically focusing on IPO evaluations. It highlights the limitations of the current framework, which primarily addresses periodic reporting and lacks a robust approach for the unique challenges associated with IPO due diligence.

articles.title: Physical-AI: From Channel Awareness to Environmental Intelligence in 6G Wireless Networks
articles.summary: The article discusses the limitations of conventional wireless networks that depend on instantaneous channel state information (CSI) and proposes a new approach called Physical-AI, which integrates environmental intelligence into 6G wireless networks. This method aims to enhance the networks' ability to manage challenges like blockage, mobility, and interference by explicitly modeling the physical environment.
